evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/walletdb.cpp to defer transaction state evaluation to AttachChain.
rationale: Fixes an assertion failure (`!wtx.isConfirmed()`) and prevents confirmed transactions from being incorrectly marked abandoned during wallet loading. According to the description and linked issue #34599, evaluating transaction states against the chain prior to AttachChain can miss intermediate blocks, leaving wallet state inconsistent and crashing the node.
